statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia.
The diagnosis codes are I47.1, I48.0, I49.9.
The procedure code is 93247 (long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study).
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197.
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or prior authorization before the service was rendered.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
